title: Simple (plain sentences for apps that don't know Stumps)
summary: People on Sideband, Columba, MeshChat or another LXMF app write "simple" and get plain sentences from the Stump instead of its compact chat lines ("rod: hi", "Private message from bob: hi", "maria joined."). "simple off" to go back. Each person is told once how. FireFly users are left alone unless they ask.
hooks: gate, priority 45: "simple" / "simple off" from LXMF apps
mesh_out: rewords what goes to people who asked; a one-time tip to the others

runtime_storage.note: Who asked for sentences, and who was told. Without an SD card it lasts until the next restart.
